method: Current official patriarchal, diocesan, vicariate, parish, mission, monastery, chapel, and worship-site sources establish published rows. Search engines, maps, civil registers, and independent directories were used only for discovery. Unclear, historical, omitted, conflicting, and outside-scope bodies remain here rather than being silently merged or published. Overlapping canonical jurisdictions are preserved neutrally.

candidates.reason: The parish appears in the documented historical four-parish Antiochian structure, but it is absent from the current first-party parish material located during this audit.

candidates.name: Additional Ukrainian Orthodox Church parishes in France
candidates.status: hold for individual current official identification
candidates.reason: The Paris rector is officially called dean of UOC parishes in France, in the plural, but the audit could individually confirm only Paris and Besançon as current parishes.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Orthodox worship community in Dunkerque

candidates.reason: An official February 2026 report documents a common prayer in Perpignan, but does not identify a parish, mission, chapel, or recurring worship site.

historical_or_reconciled.status: historically documented, absent from the current diocesan directory
historical_or_reconciled.reason: Older Ecumenical Patriarchate material identified the parish, but the current Ukrainian Orthodox Diocese directory lists only the Holy Apostle Simon community in Paris for France.

historical_or_reconciled.name: Orthodox Church of Ukraine resident structure in France
historical_or_reconciled.status: no distinct current resident body confirmed
historical_or_reconciled.reason: Official OCU France reports found during the audit concern visiting worship, delegations, or worship hosted by the Ecumenical Patriarchate. They do not establish a separate current resident OCU parish or mission.

source_reconciliations.subject: Greek Metropolis count
source_reconciliations.decision: The current page carries 59 cards. Fifty-eight are in France and the Monaco chapel is retained outside scope.

source_reconciliations.subject: Korsun France API country errors
source_reconciliations.decision: The current API returns 39 records under country code FRA. Melide and Lausanne explicitly carry Swiss addresses and coordinates, so 37 France-coded records are published and the two Swiss records are retained outside scope.

source_reconciliations.subject: Épinay-sous-Sénart Korsun records
source_reconciliations.decision: The current official API carries two separately identified chapel records at 4 rue Sainte-Geneviève. Both official records are preserved rather than silently merged, pending a source-side correction or an explicit statement that they are one institution.

source_reconciliations.subject: Sainte-Nino Georgian parish in Paris
source_reconciliations.decision: The current Greek Metropolis directory controls the parent assignment. Sainte-Nino is published under the Ecumenical Patriarchate and is not duplicated under the Georgian Patriarchate.

source_reconciliations.subject: Nilvange overlapping jurisdiction records
source_reconciliations.decision: The Greek Metropolis and ROCOR directories both claim a Holy Trinity and St Nicholas body at 22 rue de Verdun. Both current authority records are preserved under their respective parents without commentary in reader-facing data.

source_reconciliations.subject: Marseille St George overlapping jurisdiction records
source_reconciliations.decision: The Greek Metropolis and ROCOR directories both list St George at 16 rue Clapier. ROCOR marks its record temporarily unserved. Both current authority records are preserved under their respective parents.

source_reconciliations.subject: Limours Romanian institutions
source_reconciliations.decision: The Romanian parish register names the metropolitan residence church and the monastic register separately names the Protection of the Mother of God monastic community at the same address. Both institutions are preserved.

source_reconciliations.subject: Moldovan parish naming in Paris
source_reconciliations.decision: A current Orthodox Church of Moldova report names the Presentation and All Saints Protectors of Moldova parish and Father Mihail Cusnir. The current Russian Tradition directory identifies the same cleric at the Church of the Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple, already published under that canonical parent. It is not duplicated as a separately governed Moldovan jurisdiction.

source_reconciliations.subject: French overseas departments
source_reconciliations.decision: Official France rosters include Martinique and Guadeloupe bodies. They remain in the France branch because both territories are departments of France. Monaco is a separate sovereign state and remains outside scope.
